data.action: 单手轻扶生锈集装箱边缘，伫立于晨雾中远眺海面
data.camera: medium shot, side view, 侧身中景，生锈集装箱与清冷港口雾气
data.description: 伊比利亚冷雾弥漫的破旧港口旁，斯卡蒂单手扶着生锈的集装箱边缘，独自远眺翻滚的深海。海风吹拂着她如雪的长发，绯红双眸沉静而警惕。
data.lighting: 穿透海港浓雾的清冷拂晓微光
data.location: 伊比利亚沿海旧港货场
data.promptProse: Amidst cold morning mist shrouding a weathered Iberian port, Skadi stands resting one hand against a rusted shipping container, gazing out across the tumultuous dark sea. Gentle dawn light filters through the sea fog, illuminating her calm profile.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 港口晨雾的独行侧影
data.animaCaption: Standing with one hand resting against a rusted shipping container, she gazes quietly across the fog-shrouded harbor in the early dawn.
